sections.section_name: Section D - Application and Problem Solving

questions.question_text: Riya goes to the toy shop. She buys a toy car for ₹25 and a small ball for ₹12. She gives a ₹50 note to the shopkeeper. First, calculate her total bill. Next, find out how much change she will get back.
questions.answer: Step 1: Total bill is ₹25 + ₹12 = ₹37. Step 2: Change she gets back is ₹50 - ₹37 = ₹13. Riya will get ₹13 back.

questions.question_text: Look at the list of toys in a classroom: 5 Cars, 3 Dolls, and 6 Building Blocks. Which toy is the most in number? How many toys are there in total? Write down your steps.
questions.answer: Step 1: The highest number is 6, so Building Blocks are the most in number. Step 2: Total toys = 5 (Cars) + 3 (Dolls) + 6 (Blocks) = 14 toys in total.
